headline: Humana (HUM) Adds Anthropic And Aflac Veterans To Its Board
summary: Humana has elected Paul Smith, Chief Commercial Officer at AI firm Anthropic, to its Board of Directors. The company has also elected Frederick Crawford, formerly President and COO at Aflac, to its Board. Both appointments add technology, insurance and financial expertise at the board level. Humana, traded as NYSE:HUM, is adding additional technology and insurance leadership at a time when its stock has seen a mix of gains and setbacks. The share price is $366.66, with the stock up 38.6%...

headline: Medicare Advantage Insurers Are Redrawing the Map for 2027. Members Find Out by Letter This Fall.
summary: Millions of Medicare Advantage members will open a letter this fall that could quietly close doors they assume will always stay open. What insurers have already decided for 2027 and what enrollees do next could cost thousands of dollars or make coverage impossible to find.

headline: UnitedHealth Stock Ran On A Repricing The Company Described In Advance
summary: The lever behind UnitedHealth stock's climb was a Medicare Advantage repricing management had described months before the run began, and the hard part was believing a plan whose author had just been wrong.
